headline: Executive order creates a federal commission focused on improving the nation's cybersecurity.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up a Commission on Enhancing National Cybersecurity. Such commissions usually study an issue and give advice. No summary was provided, so details like the commission's members, duties, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: A new commission is formed to look at ways to strengthen the nation's cybersecurity.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 9, 2016; executive orders like this usually take effect when signed.
